versions.description: Reward players for voting for your server on server-list sites, for any game. Players type vote (or claimvote) after voting. The module asks each configured vote site whether the player voted in the last 24 hours and has not claimed yet, marks the vote as claimed and hands out currency and items. A reward that cannot be given right away (for example an item while the player is offline) is saved and given on the next vote command, never twice. Vote sites are config entries using the common server-list vote API (for example 7daystodie-servers.com, rust-servers.net, ark-servers.net, minecraft-mp.com). Voters are matched by Steam ID or, if you choose, by in-game name. Grant the VOTE_REWARDS_CLAIM permission to the roles that may claim. An optional cron job reminds players to vote; it is off by default.

commands.name: vote
commands.description: Claim your reward after voting for the server.
commands.helpText: Vote for the server on a server-list site, then type this to claim your reward.

commands.name: claimvote
commands.description: Same as vote: claim your reward after voting for the server.
commands.helpText: Vote for the server on a server-list site, then type this to claim your reward.

cronJobs.name: vote-reminder
cronJobs.description: Broadcast a reminder to vote for the server. Off by default; change the schedule to set how often.

functions.name: vote-rewards-helpers

permissions.description: Allows a player to claim rewards for voting on server-list sites.
Multiplies the vote currency reward by the count, for example 2 for double currency. Items are not multiplied.
